recommendationFailed: The last AI recommendation attempt failed
recommendationRetry: The event draft is still saved. Explicitly ask the road-event Assistant to retry the recommendation in chat.
confirmed: The duty officer confirmed this recommendation
confirmationCleared: Event details changed. Review and confirm the recommendation again.
recommendationRequired: Ask the Assistant to generate a recommendation before confirming it.
title: Road Event Command Center
subtitle: Road event draft workbench
formDescription: Record and save a road event, review AI advice with its map location, then save the duty officer's confirmation.
titlePlaceholder: For example: Rear-end collision on G312, right lane blocked
locationPlaceholder: For example: G312, kilometer 126, about 200 meters east
mapDescription: Click the map or enter coordinates. Coordinates are optional; the location description remains available if the map tiles cannot load.
mapUnavailable: Map tiles are unavailable. Enter coordinates below to continue.
mapTokenMissing: Configure a Tianditu token in the local environment to load the map.
descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the scene, impact area, and known risks.
newDraft: There is no saved draft yet.
restored: The saved draft was restored from the platform.
validationError: Check required fields: title needs 5+ characters, location 2+, and event details 10+.
coordinatesValidation: Enter both coordinates within range (latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180)
occurredAtValidation: Enter a valid occurrence date and time
saveError: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.
conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving.
